coverage_note: Guarantee-vs-probability framing, the four techniques and the negation procedure were readable; the generalised statement and every worked example were past the cut.
concepts: Pigeonhole questions are guarantee questions: a 99% probability is not a guarantee.
Method: negate the claim; if the negation is realisable the claim fails, if not it is guaranteed.
Negation rules: not(x >= n) is x <= n-1; not(x <= n) is x >= n+1.
'Some box has exactly k' is generally false even when 'some box has at least k' is guaranteed.
